$comment: The rule of the recent-folders list in ~/.plan2code/launcher.json (`recentFolders`, newest first, at most 5) as cases both writers' tests load: the launcher (src/launcher/plan2code.js) and the desktop app (plan2code-app/src-tauri/src/project.rs). A case may carry `platform`: `win32` or `posix`; it runs only with that platform's rule (a case with none runs under both). Paths are plain strings. read: `state` is the launcher.json object, `expect` the list. push: `list`, `dir`, `expect`. list: `list`, `exists` (the folders that exist), `exclude` (a folder or null), `expect`.

read.name: the list is used as it is
an empty list is used as it is, not replaced by the last folder
no list falls back to the last folder
neither key gives an empty list
an empty state gives an empty list
entries that are not strings or are empty are dropped
a list that is not an array falls back to the last folder
a list that is not an array and no last folder gives an empty list
an empty last folder is no folder
more than 5 entries are cut to 5

push.name: a first folder starts the list
an existing folder moves to the top without a duplicate
a sixth folder drops the oldest
a folder already first stays first
a trailing slash matches the bare path
a bare path matches a listed trailing slash
a trailing backslash matches the bare path
a drive root keeps its separator
the root of a posix tree is not stripped to nothing
a drive root is not the bare drive
a drive root with a slash is not the bare drive
the posix root is not an empty path
windows ignores case and keeps the new spelling

list.name: folders that are gone are skipped and the order is kept
nothing existing gives an empty list
the excluded folder matches past a trailing slash
excluding a drive root leaves the bare drive
windows excludes by folder, not by spelling
posix keeps a folder that differs only in case
